name: crewpoppy-google
description: CrewPoppy's Google Cloud edition — the crew in a Google Cloud project of your own. Not a root workspace: it takes file: links to the AgentsPoppy packages it bundles, like MemoryPoppy does, and leaves the AWS build untouched.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run design-check && npm run sync-feedback:check
scripts.install-dev: npm run build && node ${AGENTSPOPPY_REPO:-../../agentspoppy}/scripts/install-dev-extension.mjs --src . --frontend frontend/dist --backend backend/index.cjs --home ${AGENTSPOPPY_HOME:-$HOME/.agentspoppy}
